GT Pro VTX — dev shell without patching ar_ldyhs_sky
====================================================

Goal: edit scripts in /usrdata, reboot, test. Roll back by restoring stock usrdata.

PRIMARY: recovery burn (recommended)
------------------------------------
  1_INSTALL_DRIVER.cmd   (once, admin)
  2_RESET_PASSWORD.cmd   (LINK + USB when WAITING)

After normal boot:
  telnet <vtx-ip>     login root / ascent

Factory/sel are NOT flashed; only boot/env/kernel/rootfs/usrdata.

Rollback to stock login
-----------------------
  Reflash Firmware/usrdata.bin.stock.bak renamed to usrdata.bin via burn, OR
  on live unit:  touch /usrdata/fpv/dev/DISABLE_ROOT_HOOK && reboot
  (disables hook; stock empty root password behavior returns if shadow was never written)

Daily dev loop (after root works)
---------------------------------
  1. telnet root@<ip>
  2. Put experiments under /usrdata/fpv/dev/  (writable UBIFS)
  3. Optional hook call from fpv_run (only via rebuilt usrdata — never OTRA-write fpv_run)
  4. reboot; watch /tmp/air.log and your logs in /usrdata/fpv/dev/

Do NOT
------
  - OTRA-upload fpv_run_cx4861.sh, config_serial.sh, config_ether.sh (truncates → brick risk)
  - remount,rw and replace binaries under /usr or /usrdata/fpv/*.so without backup
  - run multiple OTRA sessions per boot (ACM wedges)

OTRA (live/)
------------
Emergency only if burn already done but hook file missing from usrdata.
Prefer burn with updated Firmware/usrdata.bin after hook changes.

Rebuilding usrdata.bin after editing hooks/
-------------------------------------------
Prebuilt image hash is in README_PASSWORD.txt. Changing hooks requires repacking
UBI/UBIFS (WSL + ubireader_extract / mkfs.ubifs). Until repack is automated,
use burn with the supplied usrdata.bin or ask for tools/repack_usrdata.sh update.
